ohtani.title: Jake Bauers fuels Brewers to 6-2 win over Dodgers
ohtani.blurb: Jake Bauers collects four hits and records two RBIs to lead the Brewers to a 6-2 victory over the Dodgers\n

imanaga.title: Blake Butera recaps loss to Cubs
imanaga.blurb: Blake Butera assesses Jake Irvin's outing, credits the Cubs' lineup, talks Jacob Young's offense, and names Jackson Kent tomorrow's starter

suzuki.title: Jordan Walker, Alec Burleson shine in Cardinals' win
suzuki.blurb: Jordan Walker and Alec Burleson each record three hits and four RBIs in the Cardinals' 11-4 win over the Cubs

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Ben Rice comes through in Yankees' extra-inning win
okamoto.blurb: Ben Rice hits a go-ahead two-run home run in the Yankees' 4-3 extra inning win against the Blue Jays

murakami.title: Vargas, Murakami propel White Sox to 7-5 win
murakami.blurb: Miguel Vargas and Munetaka Murakami belt clutch home runs to lead the White Sox to a 7-5 win over the Tigers

matsui.title: Casey Mize throws six scoreless frames in Padres' win
matsui.blurb: Casey Mize throws six scoreless frames, and the Padres rack up four solo home runs in their 5-0 win over the Guardians
